inserts.afterExact: One practical note: some services run directly through, while on certain schedules passengers may need to change trains at Gemas. If your ticket shows a change at Gemas, the connecting service departs from the same station, usually with a short wait. Check your itinerary when booking.
KL Sentral is connected to the KTM Komuter, MRT, LRT, monorail, KLIA Ekspres, and city buses. Arrive at least 30 minutes before departure. Stock up at station shops for the journey.

ETS trains are clean, air-conditioned, and comfortable. Each seat has adequate legroom and a fold-down tray table. Food trolley service available. Power sockets at most seats on ETS trains. Free WiFi on many services, though connectivity varies.

officialSection:
Official Information

  • KTMB lists three ETS service types: ETS Platinum (stops at only the main stations), ETS Gold (stops at more stations) and ETS Silver (almost all-stop between KL Sentral and Ipoh, lowest fares). Source: KTMB — ETS
  • KTMB's ETS timetable effective 18 April 2026 (updated 3 April 2026) lists JB Sentral as a stop, with northbound departures at 08:40, 12:45 and 16:20 and southbound arrivals at 12:15, 19:35 and 21:55. Timetables change, so check the current version. Source: KTMB ETS timetable, 18 April 2026 (PDF)
  • KTMB's onboard facilities page lists a headrest seat with a food tray, a 3-pin power outlet below the seat, an F&B bistro in Coach C, luggage racks and washrooms. Source: KTMB — ETS onboard facilities
  • Tickets are sold through KTMB's online ticketing system (KITS), linked from the KTMB timetable page. The fare for your date is shown there at booking. Source: KTMB — train timetable and ticketing
